# Copilot Instructions

All shared guidance lives in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. Follow it in full - it is platform-neutral and applies identically to GitHub Copilot (in Visual Studio Code or on GitHub.com) and to Claude Code. Read it before making changes, and its Skills and Docs sections before the tasks they list.

Apply this guidance on every request - large or small - even when the user does not explicitly ask for it.
